name: Physics Testing
purpose: Test 2D/3D physics behavior for correctness and determinism: collision layers and masks, trigger volumes, one-way platforms, joints and constraints, continuous collision detection, and fixed-timestep replay determinism with visual debug verification.
inputs: Physics engine and version with solver iteration counts and gravity vector
Fixed timestep contract with substep clamp policy
Collision matrix: layer names, mask bits, and intended interaction pairs
Determinism scope: float policy, RNG seed handling, cross-platform equality requirements
outputs: Physics test specification with collision matrix, timestep contract, and determinism verdicts
Automated layer, trigger, joint, CCD, and replay tests in the game test suite
Debug-draw capture set archived with the build under test
stop_conditions: All layer pairs, triggers, joints, and CCD cases pass with bitwise replay determinism proven
Zero tunneling events and zero masked-pair callbacks in the verification run
